title: Étale covers of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes admit finite finitely presented surjective refinements that factor locally through the cover
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: Induction on geometric fibre cardinalities must construct an integral cover despite the boundary of an étale open immersion. The proof separates the diagonal component, extends a smaller-degree refinement across the boundary, and finally descends its local factorization data to a finite finitely presented approximation.
